description: City of Phoenix Cool Pavement Evaluation (COPE) is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Ariane Middel, Arizona State University (asu.edu). Many cities around the world, including the City of Phoenix, are experiencing elevated temperatures due to the built environment that are exacerbated by climate change. Coverage: Phoenix. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: urban climate; heat mitigation; pavement; albedo; urban heat island. Published 2021-11-04. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
